question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the record labels that Headhunterz (or his earlier duo Nasty D-Tuners) signed with as a recording artist, in chronological order (the two signings in the same year in any order).
why_needs_multiple: Câu cần ba lần ký hợp đồng với hãng đĩa, phải liệt kê đủ để không bỏ sót lần nào.
criterion: Signing with a record label as a recording artist (Nasty D-Tuners or Headhunterz).

gold_events.text: Nasty D-Tuners signed to Hardcontrol Records.
Signed with major dance label Ultra Music.
